title: pipeline johnson
summary: Five deployment batches must each pass stage 1 and then stage 2, with both stages processing at most one batch at a time. Every batch must use the same order at both stages; waiting between stages is allowed. Processing times (stage1,stage2) are A=(3,8), B=(12,4), C=(6,7), D=(2,9), E=(10,3). The team must choose an order minimizing the time when all batches finish and compute that makespan.
